purpose: data-collection protocol for genuinely NEW participants to enable a future DIRECT confirmatory replication of the frozen O2.16 M4T2 + 1-vs-1 quality-monitor protocol (config 2da2cc79)

cohort.independence: ZERO overlap with NSD subj01-08; ideally a different site/scanner

per_participant_acquisition.perception: dense visual-perception fMRI sufficient to construct the frozen perception support / W_target equivalent (NSD-style repeated natural-image viewing or an equivalently certified perception localizer over the same visual ROIs)
per_participant_acquisition.imagery_identities: >=6 distinct identities: 4 CALIBRATION (balanced 2 simple-shape + 2 naturalistic-scene, matching the historical family structure) + >=2 HELD-OUT identities never entering calibration
per_participant_acquisition.repeats: >=2 imagery repetitions per identity (T=2); acquire >=2 additional held-out imagery observations per held-out identity for the native reference
per_participant_acquisition.native_reference: enough imagery observations to build participant-level R_NATIVE_ORACLE and R_FULL_CAPACITY (e.g. a high-repeat identity block) for TOTAL_RECOVERY and FULL_CAPACITY_FRACTION
per_participant_acquisition.roi: native-space or certified ventral + lateral streams ROI (streams atlas ventral=5, lateral=6) with the same ncsnr-thresholded voxel-selection policy
per_participant_acquisition.provenance: trial-level identity + repeat-position logging sufficient to reconstruct schedules WITHOUT outcome inspection; BIDS recommended

schedule_design: if >=2 repeats x >=4 calibration identities are collected with additional repeats, enumerate multiple M4T2 schedules to enable the within-participant Q-monitor association (else M4T2 operational replication still testable, monitor -> QUALITY_MONITOR_INCONCLUSIVE_FROM_DATA_STRUCTURE)
analysis: apply the frozen O2.16 module UNCHANGED (exact O2.9 M4T2 estimator; Q_MON_IN/OUT; 4-test Holm on the NEW participants only); two-stage external access seal (Stage A calibration+Q frozen before held-out; Stage B evaluate)
forbidden: reuse of the historical 8 for any effect/threshold/tuning
authorization: requires its own data-acquisition authorization (the O2.13 S3 one-time auth does NOT extend); document credentials/cost/ethics separately
on_completion: resume O2.16 confirmatory with the frozen protocol and the new cohort as replication N
